title: IdCon: A Benchmark for Identity-Consensus Diagnosis over Ambiguous Graph Embeddings
description: IdCon measures whether a system returns the consensus diagnosis of a requirement pattern over all admissible embeddings in an observed graph (Satisfies, Violates, Unknown, Empty), and at what cost. Suites: IdCon-Hard and IdCon-Hard-X (synthetic), IdCon-HPRD and IdCon-HPRD-X (HPRD graph with third-party queries), IdCon-Cite (Cora and PubMed citation graphs), and the held-out IdCon-HPRD-H and IdCon-Hard-H. The archive contains generators, importers, manifests and input hashes, references, an independent CNF/DRAT reference check, frozen predictions, method adapters, scoring and the paper source. HPRD, CEMR and Planetoid files are not included (see DATA_LICENSE.md).
